body: Thank you for reviewing and approving PR #32, and for performing the merge into lab3-staging. This is a late author acknowledgement added during the final report audit on 2 October, not a reply made before the original merge. The released product at main c551061 has now been rerun successfully: server 42/42, client 27/27, E2E 9/9, both builds, and migration status. I am updating reviewer.md and the report to distinguish original review events from these audit reconciliations.
